title: On Rescuing the crew before the second wave
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：rescue　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rescue 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the driver ① rescued the crew before the second wave twice over, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② rescues the crew before the second wave year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ rescue the crew before the second wave at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ rescued the crew before the second wave before — a line in the timetable for February 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Rescuing the crew before the second wave twice over, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ rescue the harvest in the last week year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Rescue the harvest in the last week at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ rescues the harvest in the last week twice over every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ rescued the crew before the second wave again when nobody else would.

⑩ To rescue the crew before the second wave, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody rescues the crew before the second wave year after year again and somebody must rescue the crew before the second wave twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 营救（一般过去式 rescued the crew before the second wave：1963 年司机头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 营救（一般现在 rescues the crew before the second wave：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 营救（不定式 to rescue the crew before the second wave：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 营救（过去完成时 had rescued the crew before the second wave：1957 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 营救（动名词 rescuing the crew before the second wave 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 挽回（rescue the harvest in the last week：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去挽回最后一周把收成抢回来）
G. v. 挽回（rescue the harvest in the last week：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 营救（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 rescues the harvest in the last week，而母亲又一次 rescued the crew before the second wave）

rescue 意为“营救”，结尾那句是母亲 1975 年的话：要营救在第二道浪之前救出全船人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 rescue 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the driver rescued the crew before the second wave twice over, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver rescues the crew before the second wave year after year whenever the station asks.
Rescuing the crew before the second wave twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever rescue the harvest in the last week year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station rescues the harvest in the last week twice over every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother rescued the crew before the second wave again, and the station remembered that half.
